file: UCI ServiceNow incident log, one row per incident (cache/uci_one_row.csv)
notes: A miss is the file's own "made_sla" column.
1556 items have no end in the file; they count as still open at its end.

steps.name: Reading the file and the column mapping
Checking the file can be learned from
Building what was known when each item opened
Learning on the first 70% of items
Scoring the last 30%, which it never saw
Shadow mode on the busiest later day
Finding recurring problems, then checking them on later items
Forecasting each team's workload a week ahead

cannot: Replay your floor under OpsLens's dispatch: that needs how long each item was actually worked on, who was on shift and who can handle what. A log records one way of working, not those.
